MISSION VIEJO CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING SUMMARY
  March 12, 2024
 NOTE: This Summary is for informational purposes only and is not a record of the official action taken
 by the Mission Viejo City Council. Approved City Council Meeting Minutes constitute the only record of
 official City Council action. The minutes of this meeting will be available after they are approved by

 CALL TO ORDER — City Council, Community Development Financing Authority, Housing Authority,
 Library Board of Trustees, and Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency.

 Called to Order 5:00 pm

 CLOSED SESSION

  CS1.  Labor Negotiations - The Council Will Provide Direction to its Labor Negotiator
  Pursuant to Government Code Section 54957 and 54957.6. The Parties to the
  Negotiations Are the City and City’s Unrepresented Employees. The City’s Negotiator
  is Dennis Wilberg.

 REPORT OF CLOSED SESSION

 INVOCATION: Mayor Kelley

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Vasquez

 PRESENTATIONS

  P1.  Care 4 The Children Check Presentation to the M.V. Community Foundation

  Received presentation.

  P2.  Adopted Headquarters Battalion of the 1st Marine Division Quarterly Recognition

  Presented certificates of commendation to the "Marine of the Quarter" Lance Corporal
  Nathan Heed, and "Noncommissioned Officers of the Quarter" Sergeant Nathaniel Fayard
  and Sergeant Renee Ried.

  P3  Proclaim March 2024 To Be American Red Cross Month

  Presented Proclamation.

  P4.  Presentation by Waste Management

  Received presentation.

City Council Summary  1  March 12, 2024
  PUBLIC COMMENTS

 CONSENT CALENDAR
  G/B

  1.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council meeting of February 27, 2024,
  as presented.

  2.  General Check Register Dated February 16, 2024 in the Amount of $824,957.96

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  3.  General Check Register Dated February 23, 2024 in the Amount of $1,042,018.07

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  4.  Golf Check Register Dated February 16, 2024 in the Amount of $69,162.65

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  5.  Golf Check Register Dated February 23, 2024 in the Amount of $5,602.64

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  6.  City Treasurer's Monthly Report for January 2024

  Received and filed.

  7.  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency Treasurer's Monthly Report
  for January 2024

  Received and filed.

  8.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA) Treasurer's
  Monthly Report for January 2024

  Received and filed.

  9.  Mission Viejo Housing Authority (MVHA) Treasurer's Monthly Report for January
  2024

  Received and filed.

  10.  Single Audit Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2023

  Received and filed.

City Council Summary  2  March 12, 2024
   11.  Mission Viejo Trash and Runoff Abatement Project (TRAP) – 2024 Measure M2 ECP
  Grant Application

  Adopted Resolution 24-10 Authorizing an Application for Funds for the Environmental
  Cleanup, Tier 1 Grant Program under Orange County Local Transportation Ordinance No.
  3 for the Mission Viejo Trash and Runoff Abatement Projects.

  12.  Request for a One-Time Exemption to the “No Alcoholic Beverage Consumption”
  Regulation at City facilities for a Community Event

  Approved the request for a one-time exemption to the “No Alcoholic Beverage Consumption”
  Regulation at City facilities.

  ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR

  NEW BUSINESS

  13.  Mid-Year Budget Review for FY 2023-2024
  G/K
  (1) Adopt City Resolution 24-11 Amending the FY 2023-24 Budget for Adjustments to Certain
  Revenue Sources and Operating and Capital Improvement Program Appropriations, (2)
  adopt MVHA Resolution 24-01 Amending the FY 2023-24 MVHA Budget; and (3) adopt
  Resolution 24-12 Amending the City Salary Schedule and Authorized Position Schedule to be
  effective March 16, 2024.

 CITY MANAGER REPORTS

 CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS

 COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

  14.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended ~ AB1234

  Received reports.

 Council Member Bucknum

 Council Member Goodell

 Council Member Vasquez

 Mayor Pro Tem Ruesch

 Mayor Kelley

 ADJOURNMENT AT 8:49  PM TO TUESDAY March 26, 2024 at 5:00 PM .

City Council Summary  3  March 12, 2024
